title.en: An Act Ceding the Usufruct of the Fisheries Situated in the Locality Known as Mangabul Comprised in Plan Number Ipd. Ninety-Two of the Bureau of Lands and Recently Declared By the Courts as Public Land, to the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan.

text.en:
The fisheries situated in the locality known as Mangabul, Bayambang, Pangasinan, and falling
within Plan Number Ipd. Ninety-two of the Bureau of Lands, and recently declared by the courts as public
land, is hereby reserved and the usufruct thereof ceded to the municipality of Bayambang, Province of
Pangasinan, to be used or disposed of in accordance with the general municipal law relative to the letting of
fisheries in municipal waters: Provided, That the timber and other forest products therein shall be placed under
the administration and control of the forest service: Provided, further, That this cession shall not be interpreted
as limiting the power of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources to prescribe rules and regulations
for the protection of game birds, mammals or fish within the area ceded to the municipality of Bayambang.

Upon the express or implicit approval of this Act by the President of the United States, as
provided in the Act of Congress approved on August twenty-ninth, nineteen hundred and sixteen, entitled "An
Act to declare the purpose of the people of the United States as to the future political status of the people of
the Philippine Islands, and to provide a more autonomous government for those Islands", the
Governor-General shall so announce forthwith, by means of proclamation, and this Act shall take effect on the
date of such proclamation.1
Approved, January 21, 1933.
1 Declared in force by Proclamation No. 545 (1933). See Appendix.
